subject.title: [Bug] openclaw-weixin: messages lost/duplicated; WebChat session list missing WeChat sessions (v2026.6.11)

question: Should this mixed Weixin-plugin and WebChat report remain as one cross-owner umbrella, or be split into a Tencent plugin delivery issue plus a separately reproduced Control UI issue?
rationale: The source evidence identifies a concrete external-plugin identity boundary, while the reported WebChat sidebar behavior has not been freshly reproduced on current main; maintainer ownership and tracking shape determine the safe next work.

options.title: Split by owner
options.body: Create or route the stable inbound-ID and delivery investigation to Tencent’s `openclaw-weixin` plugin, and keep only a current-main-reproduced Control UI symptom in this repository.

options.title: Keep as umbrella
options.body: Retain this issue as a cross-repository tracking report until one live reproduction proves whether the delivery and sidebar symptoms share a common core boundary.

recommendation.title: Split by owner
recommendation.body: Create or route the stable inbound-ID and delivery investigation to Tencent’s `openclaw-weixin` plugin, and keep only a current-main-reproduced Control UI symptom in this repository.

likelyOwner.reason: Tencent publishes the external channel plugin containing the concrete inbound identity boundary.
